events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A free two-day Fashion Week in-store runway experience where visitors can walk the runway and opt in to have Century 21 staff film their walk for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: A Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches, and a $21-off-$100 card are advertised for participants while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21's current official event page confirms September 15 and 16, 12–6 PM, at 22 Cortlandt Street. It explicitly says the experience is free and open to anyone, with no ticket, invitation, RSVP or online signup required. Participation and giveaway inventory remain subject to on-site capacity/supply.
events.practical_notes: Walk in to the main floor on the Dey Street side and get in line. Social filming is opt-in at the runway station.

events.address: Top of the Strand Rooftop Bar, 33 W 37th St, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A rooftop skincare pop-up with Korean skincare brand cepoLAB, creator networking, skincare experiences, refreshments and a signature Golden Hour cocktail.
events.what_is_free: The event listing advertises refreshments and a free gift for attendees.
events.caveats: Sequin Soirée's current event page confirms September 15, 1–4 PM at Top of the Strand Rooftop Bar and provides an RSVP action. The underlying RSVP destination was not independently surfaced in search, so the event page is retained as the actionable registration source rather than inventing a direct URL.
events.practical_notes: Registration is expected. Use the RSVP action on the event page before traveling; rooftop capacity may be limited.

events.event_name: Levi's Wear Longer Project × The New York Sewing Center
events.brand: Levi's × The New York Sewing Center
events.address: The New York Sewing Center, 246 W 38th St Suite 9A, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A free Levi's Wear Longer Project workshop teaching teens how to repair, refresh and personalize a garment.
events.what_is_free: The workshop itself is free and ticketed.
events.caveats: Current NYC event listings agree on September 16, 4–6 PM at The New York Sewing Center and explicitly state that this is a free ticketed event for teens ages 14–18 with registration required. The registration action is available from the event page; no separate direct registration URL was independently verified in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Age-restricted to teens 14–18. Register through the event listing before traveling.

events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A Medik8 skincare pop-up at Sephora SoHo with free samples and personalized skincare consultations. A separate Ariana Madix meet-and-greet follows the September 16 daytime pop-up.
events.what_is_free: Free skincare samples and personalized consultations during the public pop-up hours.
events.caveats: The current Partiful listing confirms the September 16 pop-up at Sephora SoHo, with free samples and consultations from 12–5:30 PM. It explicitly states that a Partiful ticket does not guarantee entry. The 6–8 PM Ariana Madix meet-and-greet is a separate purchase-qualified opportunity limited to the first 150 eligible customers who buy two or more full-size Medik8 products; that purchase requirement does not apply to the daytime samples/consultations.
events.practical_notes: Use the Partiful registration, but treat admission as capacity-dependent rather than guaranteed. Do not confuse the free daytime pop-up with the purchase-qualified Ariana Madix wristband program.
